_comment: Shared project settings for cont_exchange_v2.0 — committed to repo.
Personal/per-user allow lists belong in .claude/settings.local.json
(which is gitignored).
What this file does:
- permissions.deny: blocks destructive operations regardless of
individual allow rules. Cannot be overridden by settings.local.json.
- hooks.UserPromptSubmit: runs tools/auto-archive-attachments.py BEFORE
each user prompt is shown to the assistant; parses <document> blocks
and stores each attachment under incoming-docs/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>-
<sha8>.md (dedup by SHA1). Documented in CLAUDE.md §0a 'Auto-archive
of chat attachments'. Registered here (not in settings.local.json)
per AUDIT-001 T-AUDIT-004 so every developer gets archiving out of
the box.
- hooks.PostToolUse: runs scripts/hooks/post_edit_hint.py after every
Edit/Write to surface project-specific reminders (rebuild, init.sql
semantics, bundle hash verification, CALC-card updates, etc), scoped
to the single file just edited and delivered via additionalContext
so the model actually sees it (plain stdout does not reach the
model on PostToolUse — see incoming-docs, 'Золотая середина...').
- hooks.SessionStart/SubagentStart/SubagentStop: append one JSON line
per event to .claude/logs/agents.jsonl (log_subagents.py) so
tools/agents_report.py can show which subagents actually get
called, to calibrate .claude/rules/agent-routing.md.
- hooks.Stop: money_path_guard.py refuses to end the turn (exit 2)
if money-path files changed and code-reviewer never ran in this
session — the one call the routing rule always requires.
- env.CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=1: subagents cannot spawn
further subagents; all delegation stays visible in the main thread.
Encodes the lessons of PR-F02-001..016 + PR-AUDIT-004 — every footgun
we hit becomes a hook reminder or a deny rule.
